- Billing group: `basic`
- Product Gate: `none`
- Cache: `enabled`, TTL `5m0s`, boundary `none`
- Response family: `code-refer-v1`
- Official documentation: <https://dev.qweather.com/docs/api/minutely/minutely-precipitation/>

| Flag | Required | Type | Constraints/default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--place` | no | `string` | — | human place name to resolve |
| `--place-id` | no | `string` | — | QWeather Location ID |
| `--coordinate` | no | `string` | — | coordinate in geo:<lat>,<lon> form |
| `--country` | no | `string` | — | ISO-3166 country or region filter for --place |
| `--adm` | no | `string` | — | administrative-area filter for --place |
| `--lang` | no | `string` | — | response language |
